orders.text:
AO No. 299 of 2010 
Hon’ble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.
Mr. D.S. Patni, Advocate for the appellant. 
Admit. 
Notices on behalf of respondent nos. 1 to 4 
have been accepted by Mr. D.C.S. Rawat, Advocate. 
Issue notice to respondent no. 5 returnable 
within three weeks. Steps to be taken within one 
week from today. 
List this matter on 20.10.2010, in the daily 
cause list. 
The effect and operation of the judgment and 
order dated 31.5.2010 passed by the Motor Accident 
Claim Tribunal, Pauri Garhwal in Motor Accident 
Claim Petition No. 49 of 2007 Smt. Malti Devi and 
others Vs. National Insurance Company Limited and 
another shall remain stayed subject to the following 
condition: 
The applicant shall deposit a sum of 
Rs.5,00,000/- (adjusting the amount already 
paid) before the M.A.C.T, Pauri Garhwal. 
A sum of Rs. 3,00,000/- out of the decretal 
amount can be withdrawn by the 
claimants/respondent nos. 1 to 4 without furnishing 
any security. The balance amount shall be kept by the 
Tribunal concerned in a fixed deposit, so that it could 
earn interest, which would be subject to further 
orders of the Court. 
The Registry is directed to remit the amount of 
Rs. 25,000/- deposited before this Court to the 
Tribunal concerned within three weeks from today. 
This amount will be adjusted in the decretal amount 
to be deposited by the appellant. 
 (Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.) 
21.9.2010 
Rathour

AO No.299 of 2010 
Hon’ble B.S. Verma, J.
Ms. Joyce Irwin, Advocate holding brief of Mr. D.S. 
Patni, Advocate for the appellant. 
Mr. D.C.S. Rawat, Advocate for the respondent. 
Respondent no.5 has not been served. 
Learned counsel for the appellant is directed to 
take fresh steps to serve respondent no.5 within a week. 
Summon the lower court record. 
List thereafter. 
 (B.S. Verma, J.) 
 15.03.2013 
Rajni
